title: Doozy Vape Co Infinity Mango Guava Ice 50/50 Shortfill E-Liquid 100ml
description: Mango Guava Ice by Doozy Infinity is a tropical fruit blend with a bright, juicy character and a fresh, icy finish. Sweet Mango delivers a rich, nectar-like base, while Guava adds a fresher, tangier note that lifts the flavour with its mellow sweetness. A streak of cool Ice rounds it off, bringing some delightful refreshment to this perfect pairing of fresh fruit flavours. Blended at a 50VG/50PG ratio, this MTL-compatible shortfill is ideal for pod systems, vape pens and starter kits. Each 120ml bottle contains 100ml of nicotine-free e-liquid, with space to add two 10ml nic shots to customise your strength. The Doozy Infinity Podfill range delivers full-on flavour, smooth throat hits and satisfying vapour, all in a format designed for easy, refillable MTL vaping.
